Callout.Name: Snake Bite
Callout.Message: Walker bitten by a snake on a trail.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, bite to the calf, remote location.

Script.Line: It was on the path, in the shade.
It went for my calf and it was gone before I saw it properly.
I have put my leg up and I have not moved since.

Callout.Patient: It is going numb. Is that normal?

Lines.Approach: Bitten on the leg and a long way from the road. Keep him still and get to him.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
